text: 2026-05-29 — Major refactor for long-term maintainability. Added: (1) crawlTeacherIncremental for selective recrawl, (2) granular detectDriveChange returning changed/new/removed CourseIds, (3) snapshotUserEdits + Trạng thái/Ghi chú columns preserved across syncs, (4) ensureTab no longer deletes existing tabs (preserves sheetId), (5) lesson-level checksums in sync-state, (6) orphan archive via rename instead of delete, (7) end-of-run report with per-tab lesson diff. All syntax-checked + dry-run tested on Thầy Đức TENS.

Session 2026-05-29: Fixed render.js sub-row empty Tên cells. When a lesson has multiple files in a resource column (nRows > 1), rows i>0 had blank Tên cells to the left of the resource links. Fix: for i>0, look at the first non-empty resource cell in that row, write "↳ <label>" (with same indent) as a hyperlink into the Tên cell. Arrow visually signals continuation without repeating the full lesson name.

Session note: User asked to save the working method into agent memory/agents. The adaptive-drive-to-sheet agent should remember the sub-row Tên-cell rule: when a lesson has multiple files, fill blank sub-row Tên cells with a hyperlink labeled `↳ <file label>` using the first non-empty resource cell in that row. This was appended to FACT.md and logged in JOURNAL.

Completed full crawl + sync for all 9 math teachers and setup daily automation via CherryClaw cron.

Automation Details:
- Job 1 (1:00 AM): node sync-many.js --subject "toan" --list-changes (preview only)
- Job 2 (2:00 AM): node sync-many.js --subject "toan" --sync --no-auto-refresh (apply changes)
- Checkpoint system: sync-states/<teacherId>.json tracks course + lesson checksums
- Incremental by default: Only changed courses are recrawled, unchanged skipped
- User edits preserved: Trạng thái + Ghi chú columns always preserved
- Performance: ~60s daily (1-2 courses changed), ~5m (5+ courses changed)

Created documentation:
- AUTOMATION-SETUP.md (full guide)
- AUTOMATION-QUICKREF.md (quick reference)

Fixed bug in render.js: 3 courses "1./2./3. VẬT LÝ 12/11/10 (2027)" (teacher Chu Văn Biên, id 1gkr0G-1WzlNfjJd5roMLWLE0q8KHbjE5) all collapsed into ONE tab "VẬT LÝ" because shortCourseLabel fallback took only first 2 words, dropping the grade number. Two fixes: (1) fallback now keeps a trailing numeric token (→ "VẬT LÝ 12/11/10"); (2) added dedupeTabNames(plan, shortenFn) which appends " (2)/(3)" suffix for any remaining collisions, called BEFORE diffCourse so diff matches the unique tabName. Re-run of 5 failed teachers + VĂN Sương Mai fix started. Root causes: (1) isMetaCourse giai doan filter bug — checked `c.id` which every tree node has, wrongly matching ALL children. Fix: check `Array.isArray(gc.children)` to identify actual folder grandchildren. (2) ensureTab 400 "already exists" — added try/catch with metadata re-fetch. (3) VĂN Sương Mai was processed before isMetaCourse fix (teacher [9/34]). sync-state deleted → full re-render. All 6 re-runs running sequentially with 15s delays to avoid rate limits.

Hardened drive-to-sheet tab-naming to definitively solve duplicate-folder-name collisions. dedupeTabNames now: case-insensitive comparison (tabKey lowercase+trim, matching Google Sheets uniqueness), B1 expand-label / B2 numeric-suffix / B3 fail-loud post-condition assertion (throws if any dup remains). Added shortCourseLabel patterns: bracket-tag strip, GĐx.Ty phase pattern, fallback separator-cut (-–|:/). Verified across 4 live teachers (Chu Văn Biên, Trịnh Đình Thành, Đỗ Văn Đức, Sương Mai) + adversarial self-tests (all-identical, case-only, 10-dup) — all PASS, no regression. Documented full 2-layer logic in agent spec adaptive-drive-to-sheet.md "Tab naming" section. Still DRY_RUN — not yet applied with --sync.

Fixed shortCourseLabel tab naming bugs in render.js:
1. KHOÁ regex now matches both "KHOÁ" (old spelling, accent on A) and "KHÓA" (new spelling, accent on O) via /^KH[OÓ][ÁA]\s+/i
2. Separator split changed from /[-–|:/]/ to /\s[-–]\s|[|:]/ — hyphens only split when surrounded by spaces (fixes "V-ACT"→"V", "ZOOM-H"→"ZOOM")
3. Fallback word count increased from 2 to 3 (fixes "COMBO CẤP"→"COMBO CẤP TỐC", "BỘ CÂU"→"BỘ CÂU HỎI", etc.)
4. Added Pattern 6: ZOOM-X recognition
5. Added Pattern 2b: "Live - <subject>" (LIVE without code, followed by separator)
6. VOD pattern now consumes optional separator after "VOD" (fixes "VOD - Địa lí" → "VOD Địa lí 12")
7. expandLabelFromName also updated with same separator fix
8. Numeric token check in fallback now at index [3] (was [2]) and allows up to 4 digits
